name: NRC 2012 swine feed ingredient nutrient library
notes: Ingredient loading values should be transcribed from NRC 2012 Chapter 17 or the official NRC Swine Model 2012 companion workbook.
Do not silently mix ingredient composition values from other databases into this library. Any local laboratory or supplier override must carry its own provenance.
Keep values on the basis published by NRC; conversions for formulation belong in code, not in the source data.
